title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER weighted roadmap scorecard
lineage: WorkPass 6 selectively integrates useful changes based on HOTFIX_CHAT v20 2026-10-09; no wholesale legacy-tree overlay.
method: Weighted workstream estimate: each fixed weight is multiplied by the evidence-based completion fraction. Percent is implementation roadmap progress, not release readiness. The retrieval candidate metric was tested on a synthetic fixture only; no production-corpus uplift is claimed.
